import requests

# Let's check NCBI RefSeq or Ensembl for MLXIPL and ARFIP2
# Also check if MLXIPL has isoforms (ChREBP-alpha, ChREBP-beta)
url = "https://rest.ensembl.org/lookup/symbol/homo_sapiens/MLXIPL?expand=1"
r = requests.get(url, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
if r.status_code == 200:
    ens_data = r.json()
    print("Ensembl MLXIPL transcripts:")
    for t in ens_data.get('Transcript', []):
        trans_id = t.get('id')
        trans_len = t.get('length')
        biotype = t.get('biotype')
        t_name = t.get('display_name')
        t_trans = t.get('Translation', {})
        t_prot_len = t_trans.get('length') if t_trans else None
        print(f"  {trans_id} ({t_name}): trans_len={trans_len}, prot_len={t_prot_len}, biotype={biotype}")

url2 = "https://rest.ensembl.org/lookup/symbol/homo_sapiens/ARFIP2?expand=1"
r2 = requests.get(url2, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
if r2.status_code == 200:
    ens_data2 = r2.json()
    print("\nEnsembl ARFIP2 transcripts:")
    for t in ens_data2.get('Transcript', []):
        trans_id = t.get('id')
        trans_len = t.get('length')
        biotype = t.get('biotype')
        t_name = t.get('display_name')
        t_trans = t.get('Translation', {})
        t_prot_len = t_trans.get('length') if t_trans else None
        print(f"  {trans_id} ({t_name}): trans_len={trans_len}, prot_len={t_prot_len}, biotype={biotype}")
